headline: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
title: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Red-Eyes Black Dragon. What is it? It is a Level seven DARK Dragon Normal Monster with two thousand four hundred attack. It is Joey's ace card. What does it do? It has no effect, but it has big potential, and many Red-Eyes cards are built around it. How do you use it? Red-Eyes Fusion lets you Fusion Summon a monster that lists a Red-Eyes monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck or field, and the summoned monster's name becomes Red-Eyes B. Dragon. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
